title: Focused ultrasound-mediated delivery of viral neuronal tracers in marmosets.
abstract: In this issue of Cell Reports Methods, Parks et al. present an approach to non-invasively deliver adeno-associated viruses in a marmoset model using focused ultrasound (FUS) for neuronal tracing. The optimization of this technique in this non-human primate model is highly valuable for future FUS-mediated drug delivery studies.
